summary.text: Dragon Flow Escape is Myriad Tidal Dragon's killer move. Countless white dragon phantoms encircle targets and charge forward like a river of light.

claims.text: Facing a soul beast army in immemorial black heaven, Central Continent’s three rank eight Gu Immortals need to escape with three Immortal Gu Houses. Myriad Tidal Dragon offers this method. He must bring himself, the three houses, and many Gu Immortals. Once he uses the move, he will not be able to fight for the next three days. Dragons roar. Flying dragon phantoms encircle the three houses and charge with them. The soul beast army howls and blocks them in multiple layers. By charging relentlessly, the move forces an opening and the three houses escape. He dares not deactivate it and keeps fuelling it through a six hour chase until the soul beasts give up, drawn to a group of dark venomous snakes. He then says he is spent and needs to rest for seven days before he can do anything again. After he stops the move, he falls backwards into deep sleep. His snore sounds like the roaring of dragons. Fog forms a cocoon around him that thickens into a pale white dragon egg.
